81fcd121c1: 💡 The [이름] (Name) box at the top shows the printer you chose ([컬러출력] (Color) or [흑백출력] (B&W)). Don't change it.
d3701817f4: You're back in the print window. In the [크기설정] (Size) tab, check [용지 크기에 맞춤] (Fit to paper) to fill the paper with the photo. To keep the photo's shape, choose [용지 비율에 맞춤] (Fit to paper ratio).
b8a3225d9e: In the [여백/위치] (Margins/Position) tab, set the top · bottom · left · right margins (mm) and where to place the photo.
fa5b9c02be: Set the number of copies and print
0817d066c7: In the [기타] (Other) tab, set how many to print. Check everything in the preview on the left, then press [인쇄] (Print).
1fc6287610: Press [인쇄] (Print) and the PIN box appears. Type any 4 digits. We suggest the last 4 digits of your phone number.
992b51bde9: Not sure what to do at the printer machine?See ‘Printing at the printer machine’ below ⬇
e2995cac54: How to print a TOEIC certificate TOEIC · TOEIC Speaking
e0094573d0: For TOEIC · TOEIC Speaking (YBM) certificates, first print on the PC with [증명서전용PIN9999] (certificate printer). If you choose another printer, the PC freezes!
91b4f37503: ⚠️ Just issuing (paying) on the website does not print it Please read this
5449006e56:
A certificate comes out only after you ① send it to print on the PC with [증명서전용PIN9999], then ② find it at the printer machine with number 9999 and pay.
If you don't send it on the PC and only type 9999 at the printer machine, nothing comes out.
3927c33e00: Open the certificate on the website
935e55d3a1: When you get your score report on the TOEIC website, the certificate opens in a viewer window.
7aef32a692: Picture guides for university transcripts, graduation certificates and Certpia are coming soon. For those certificates too, choose the [증명서전용PIN9999] printer.
5f6a1be15d: Certificate viewer window, with the yellow score report print button at the top right marked 1
71add2ee1a:
Press the yellow [성적표 출력] (Print score report) at the top right of the viewer.
[테스트 출력] (Test print) is only for testing. Don't press it.
da276d333d: Printer selection window, choosing [증명서전용PIN9999] from the list and pressing Print
fa9fbef470: In the printer window, choose [증명서전용PIN9999] and press [인쇄] (Print).
6986ffffc8: ⚠️ If you choose [흑백출력] (B&W) · [컬러출력] (Color), the PC freezes! Then it's hard to get back the certificate fee. Only choose [증명서전용PIN9999].
d77adaedfc: Done when it says printing is finished!
6234cff847:
[증명서전용PIN9999] doesn't show a PIN box. 9999 is entered automatically, so this is normal.
When it says printing is complete, you're done on the PC.
578fd628c5: Find it at the printer machine with number 9999
bf39fe1803:
At the printer machine, press [인쇄] (Print) → [PC] and type 9999.
When the list appears, choose only your certificate, press [시작] (Start), then pay.
bec10b3d7a: ⚠️ Other customers may have used 9999 too, so several documents may be in the list. Check the time and name and pay only for yours. Don't press [모두선택] (Select all).
e24533e7f7: Printing at the printer machine Same for Edge · Chrome · ALSee
2f2a96c660: Do these steps after you type the PIN on the PC and send the print job. It's the same for Edge, Chrome and ALSee.
82ada80ea4: On the printer machine: Print → PC → type the number
4073c80670:
Go to the printer machine and press [인쇄] (Print) → [PC].
In the PIN box, type the 4-digit number you used on the PC and touch [OK].
91725efdd2: Printer machine screen showing the print job list after typing the PIN
0eda929fcc:
When the list appears, carefully check what it shows: document name, time, B&W/color, two-sided/one-sided, pages, paper size, etc.
Make sure it is your document and the print options are what you wanted.
3dafd06efe:
Touch your document in the list, then touch the [시작] (Start) button.
If there are several, press [모두 인쇄] (Print all) at the top, or touch only the ones you want and press [시작] (Start).
e16eb5fb3d: Finally, the payment info screen [과금정보] appears. Check everything carefully, and if the price is right too, touch [확인] (OK).
abdd5e40e0: ⚠️ If the pages or price on the payment info screen are different from what you expect, do NOT pay.
7772e7ee2b: When the card reader speaks, insert your IC card (credit/debit), or hold Samsung Pay to it.
99934d01f4: 💳 Insert your credit/debit card into the card reader slot, chip side in.
